releaseNotes: Prepare the package for npm: drop the private flag, keep the two Cloudflare Workers out of the tarball, and add a release workflow that publishes through npm trusted publishing when a GitHub release is published.
Raise the Node.js floor to 24, the active LTS whose bundled npm supports trusted publishing. .nvmrc, .node-version, engines.node, CI, and @types/node move together.

The pack smoke test now requires surfaces/workspace-template/repo-agent-entrypoints/.claude/settings.json, restored on main in 0.218.8, so a checkout that lacks it fails the audit before it fails a consumer. .npmignore re-includes it explicitly.
b2c setup prints the portable npx registration form when the package was installed from npm, and skips the npm link advice that only applies to a checkout.
